summary.en: Beika Shopping Centre is holding a jack-o'-lantern carving contest for halloween. One night, Kuwano and Kajiyama are walking home at night when they pass a road with jack-o'-lantern placed in front of the houses. Suddenly the wind blows strong, and three ghosts with jack-o'-lantern-shaped head appear. The next day, Conan goes to Poirot because Kogoro and Ran are going out. There, Azusa is making some jack-o'-lantern and, in exchange for a milk tea, she asks Conan to help her. They later talk about the story behind halloween. Azusa then mentions about the appearance of jack-o'-lantern ghost, which became a hot topic after many people saw it last night. Conan then ask about Amuro whereabout, to Azusa answers that he is taking a few days off. She wishes that could put a collar on Amuro and keep him at Poirot. She decide to ask Conan something about Amuro, but get interupted by Tamie Kono, Tomomi Kashiyama, and Satoshi Mizunuma, whose jack-o'-lanterns have been stolen. Victim: Tamie Kono, Tomomi Kashiyama, and Satoshi Mizunuma Age: 50 years old (Kono), 29 years old (Kashiyama) & 60 years old (Mizunuma) Robbed items: 3 Jack-o'-lanterns Conan and Azusa decide to check the neighborhood to find who stole the jack-o'lanterns.
